scenarios.title: Add clamp(x, min, max) to src/math.js
scenarios.body:
Add a `clamp(x, min, max)` function to `src/math.js` and export it. It returns `min` when `x < min`, `max` when `x > max`, otherwise `x`.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `clamp` is exported from `src/math.js`.
- [ ] Tests in `test/math.test.js` cover below, inside and above the range.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.

oracle.check: const m=require('./src/math'); return m.clamp(5,0,3)===3 && m.clamp(-1,0,3)===0 && m.clamp(2,0,3)===2

scenarios.title: slugify keeps repeated dashes for repeated spaces
scenarios.body:
`slugify('Hello  World')` (two spaces) returns `hello--world`; expected `hello-world`. Leading and trailing whitespace must not produce dashes either.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] A regression test in `test/strings.test.js` fails before the fix and passes after.
- [ ] `slugify('Hello  World')` returns `hello-world`.
- [ ] `npm test` passes.

oracle.check: const s=require('./src/strings'); return s.slugify('Hello  World')==='hello-world' && s.slugify('  A b ')==='a-b'

scenarios.title: Add multiply and divide to the math module
scenarios.body:
Two independent deliverables. Deliver each as its own child issue and PR, then close this parent when both children are done.

1. `multiply(a, b)` in `src/math.js`, with tests.
2. `divide(a, b)` in `src/math.js` that throws an `Error` when `b` is 0, with tests.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Two child issues exist, each closed by a merged PR.
- [ ] Both functions are exported and tested.
- [ ] This parent is closed after both children are closed.

oracle.check: const m=require('./src/math'); let threw=false; try { m.divide(1,0); } catch (e) { threw=true; } return m.multiply(3,4)===12 && m.divide(8,2)===4 && threw
